opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Trust contributes 100% of salary costs up to £56,000 in year one, then 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three; plus up to £6,000 per annum in research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post; must hold a doctorate by take-up; must hold a UK degree or a UK academic position; fellowships tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowships for early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research. Approximately 145 fellowships available in 2027. All subject areas except studies of disease/illness and research informing clinical practice.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants

next_open_date.raw: autumn 2026 (outline applications in new grants management system)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers based at UK universities or other institutions of higher education; UK-based independent research institutes/organisations eligible on a trial basis; applicants employed by eligible institution or academics with close links following retirement
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative and original research projects, held for up to five years. Two-stage process: outline applications (currently paused, accepted in new grants management system autumn 2026) and detailed applications (open, deadline 1 September 2026 for invited applicants). At least 75% of resources must fund research staff.
discipline_tags: All disciplines except medical/clinical research, policy, commercial, database-focused research

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications made by a member of academic staff based in a UK university with research degree awarding powers; some specialist arts institutions permitted; host institution must administer the grant
opportunities.summary: Enables UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring novel expertise and enhance skills/knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research. Visits last 3-12 months. All subject areas except studies of disease/illness and research informing clinical practice.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post; live in UK at least 26 weeks of year; held teaching/research post at a UK university or UKRI-eligible independent research organisation at retirement
opportunities.summary: Supports senior researchers who have retired or partially retired to complete a research project and prepare results for publication. Fellowships tenable for 3-24 months. Application materials available on page during September 2026.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the Fellowship; resident in UK; permanent member of UK scholarly community with established track record
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers, particularly those prevented by routine duties from completing original research, to complete a piece of research. Fellowships tenable for 3-24 months. Approximately 100 fellowships offered each year. Application materials available on page in September 2026.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million (up to £1m per year for up to 10 years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students holding their own research degree awarding powers; may be single university or collaboration; international institutions encouraged as partners
opportunities.summary: Funding for UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. The Leverhulme Centenary Research Centre round expected to open February 2027 for outline applications in June 2027. Previously excluded institutions (Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial) eligible in this round.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented early career scholars embarking on a university career; at least two years full-time experience post-PhD; hold permanent academic appointment at UK university at lecturer level or be nominated by a UK university; at early career stage without team leadership experience
opportunities.summary: The Centenary Research Leadership Awards will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028. Supports talented early career scholars to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem. Awards of up to £1 million for staff salaries and associated costs, run over 4-5 years. Each institution limited to one bid.
discipline_tags: All disciplines except medical/clinical research, policy, commercial, database-focused research
